nodes.label: Patient presented with severe back pain, light-headedness, and chest pain
Patient is a woman in her 40s with a medical history of infective endocarditis and hepatitis C secondary to ongoing intravenous drug use
Patient recently underwent tricuspid valve replacement with a 29-mm bioprosthetic Carpentier-Edwards valve complicated by transient third-degree heart block
Two days after pacemaker placement, patient experienced episodes of light-headedness and chest pain
Physical examination showed blood pressure of 94/60 mm Hg and heart rates between 150 and 190 beats per minute
ECG shows regularly irregular rhythm with grouped beating and 1 P wave producing 2 QRS complexes
TEE shows pulmonic valve vegetations and severe tricuspid regurgitation
TEE shows severe tricuspid regurgitation from a flail leaflet with right heart volume overload
Prosthetic valve endocarditis complicated by pacemaker-related or AV conduction arrhythmia
Prosthetic valve endocarditis complicated by pacemaker-related or AV conduction arrhythmia
Right-sided infective endocarditis involving the native pulmonic valve and prosthetic tricuspid valve
